_comment: Jurisdiction table. Authority NAMES are real and public; every EMAIL here is a
non-routable placeholder on the reserved .invalid TLD, deliberately, so that a
misconfigured run cannot reach a real regulator. Real contact addresses belong in
authorities.json, which overrides this file and is not committed.
Keys are lowercased state and city names as returned by reverse geocoding.
